title: SurfacePsycho features table
description: Shape of docs/features_table.yaml and the values allowed in its catalog, tags and testing-status columns. VS Code reports violations inline through the yaml.schemas setting of .vscode/settings.json.

id.description: Node group name, prefixed with 'SP - '. It doubles as the asset name in Blender.

catalog.description: The single category the feature is filed under in the asset library. null means not filed yet.

tags.description: Free-form labels used for searching. The catalog and the primitive family are always the first tags.

testing-status.description: How much automated testing covers the feature. none: untested. light: a test exists but covers little.

Comment.description: Working note, typically a planned merge or rename. Omit the key when there is nothing to say.

file.description: Name of the .blend file at the quest folder top level owning the node group, or null when none does. Filled by .tooling/update_features_table.py.
